- Large Language Model (OpenAI GPT or Doubao).
- Ultrasonic, camera, and built-in expressive actions.
API key, or the API key for any other supported LLM.
Both language versions are placed in the same directory:

blocks.html: cd ~/picar-x/example
sudo python3 21.voice_active_car_gpt.py
"Hey buddy"
sudo python3 21.voice_active_car_doubao_cn.py
"你好 滴滴"

sections.title: Switching to Other LLMs or TTS

inlines.v: You can easily switch to other LLMs, TTS, or STT languages with just a few edits:
To switch, simply modify the initialization part in the code:

blocks.code:
from picarx.llm import Gemini as LLM
llm = LLM(api_key="YOUR_KEY", model="gemini-pro")

# Set models and languages
TTS_MODEL = "en_US-ryan-low"
STT_LANGUAGE = "en-us"
